review.notes: Full review of the 4191-line README and all nine Lean files (only README, Suggested.lean and the new ChevalleyModelTargets.lean differ from main; no change outside the folder). Gate: every check passes; independent depcheck 204 roadmaps/1494 edges/0 problems; lake env lean on Suggested.lean gives nine sorry warnings only, on ChevalleyModelTargets.lean two. Previous review's R05 (6B generality) repaired and R08 partly (7c/7d/11B Checks and locators); R01 (companion docstrings attribute owned constructions to the open consumers FormalConnectionsOpers and InverseGalois), R02 (admitted data constructors in six companions, plus the new canonicalSCInput) and R03 (SCRealizationInput admits the zero-root torus model) unrepaired and blocking (P2). P3: companion import form, companion padding, missing Checks blocks and sources.toml, three locator slips, gap without a plan file. Seeded sample of 15 sections verified at their locators in legally fetched texts (Milne 2017 author-page copy, Jantzen 1985 MPIM preprint, Conrad luminysga3, Dudas-Michel 2015, SGA 1 arXiv, Arzhantsev, Ernst, Conrad-Feng Dec 2020, Fang-Lim-Tan). Adversarial table of 95 computed rows covers the sample, all nine headlines and every finding witness. One-tactic probe closes none of the nine headlines; #check scaffold on all 28 declarations keeps every README binder.
